description: Update an existing appointment group by id — only the fields you pass are changed — and return the updated group object. Set publish=true to make a draft group visible to participants; Canvas will not let you set it back to false once published. Add new_appointments as [start_at, end_at] ISO 8601 pairs to create additional time slots — existing slots are left alone and there is no removal here. This tool cannot change participant_type, participant_visibility, or the per-participant appointment limits set at create_appointment_group; those are fixed at creation. Find the id with list_appointment_groups. Requires permission to manage the Scheduler in the group's context.

new_appointments.description: New time slots to add as [start_at, end_at] pairs

publish.description: Set to true to publish the group

name: update_appointment_group
title: Update Appointment Group
